name: @sillo/agent
description: Teach Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex the Sillo Python framework. Installs version-aware Sillo skills into the coding agent you already use.
author: Chidebele Dunamis

scripts.validate: npm run -s build && node dist/cli/main.js dev validate
scripts.validate:skills: npm run -s build && node dist/cli/main.js dev validate --skills-only
scripts.coverage:gaps: npm run -s build && node dist/cli/main.js dev gaps --surface framework/surface
scripts.eval:routing: npm run -s build && node dist/cli/main.js dev eval
scripts.skill:new: npm run -s build && node dist/cli/main.js dev new-skill
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm test
scripts.render: npm run -s build && node dist/cli/main.js dev render --out .render
